snippet.title: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4931970/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=gameplay-trailer

The free demo is out now, it’s in Steam Next Fest (October 19–26), and the full game arrives November 4 on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Play tonight’s Nightly free at https://moondoku.com or in the iPhone and iPad app.
